"""Cycle member ``a``: package head, one half of the second component.

The stage's whole point is the pair of components below.  ``{a, b.c}`` and
``{a.b, c}`` are DISJOINT strongly connected components of the same kind
whose sorted member names concatenate to one identical dotted text,
``a.b.c`` — so a key that flattened its members into a single string would
report one cycle where the producer found two.
"""

from b.c import GAMMA_BASE

A_TAG = "a"


def a_step(value: int) -> int:
    return value + GAMMA_BASE
